title: Blonde Cheerleader Poses
description: Four identical cartoon illustrations of a blonde female cheerleader in a black and yellow uniform, shown side by side against a solid dark gray background. Each figure stands in a dynamic pose with one leg forward, pointing forward with her right arm while looking toward the viewer.
prompt: Four identical cartoon cheerleader girls with voluminous bright yellow hair, wearing black and yellow cropped tops with 'W' logo, black shorts with yellow trim, and black and yellow boots.
